title: On Recycling the water from the washing
subtitle: 循环利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）
meta: 主题语境：循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）　|　核心词汇：recycle　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 recycle 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the trader ① recycled the water from the washing at once, and every partner in the market said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the trader ② recycles the water from the washing in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ recycle the water from the washing at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ recycled the water from the washing before — a line in the list for October 1983 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Recycling the water from the washing at once, the trader said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far stall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ recycle the bottles three times over in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Recycle the bottles three times over at once and never mention it again.

By 1996 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new partner from the next market ⑧ recycles the bottles three times over at once every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ recycled the water from the washing again when nobody else would.

⑩ To recycle the water from the washing, my mother said in 2001, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the market remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the market forgets, somebody recycles the water from the washing in the rain again and somebody must recycle the water from the washing at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 回收利用（一般过去式 recycled the water from the washing：1989 年货商头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 回收利用（一般现在 recycles the water from the washing：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 回收利用（不定式 to recycle the water from the washing：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 回收利用（过去完成时 had recycled the water from the washing：1983 年十月的货单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 回收利用（动名词 recycling the water from the washing 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 再利用（recycle the bottles three times over：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去再利用把那些瓶子重复用上三回）
G. v. 再利用（recycle the bottles three times over：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 回收利用（后段两处：新来的伙计照例 recycles the bottles three times over，而母亲又一次 recycled the water from the washing）

answers.why: recycle 意为“回收利用”，1989 年货商二话不说地回收利用把洗过东西的水再用一遍，那是集市里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 recycled。
recycle 意为“回收利用”，自那以后货商淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 recycles。
recycle 意为“回收利用”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯回收利用把洗过东西的水再用一遍”，此处为不定式 to recycle the water from the washing。
recycle 意为“回收利用”，货单里 十月 那行字说明早在 1996 年之前就有人回收利用过，故用过去完成时 had recycled。
recycle 意为“回收利用”，货商说“回收利用把洗过东西的水再用一遍这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 recycling the water from the washing 作主语。
recycle 意为“再利用”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去再利用把那些瓶子重复用上三回”，should ever 之后用原形 recycle the bottles three times over。
recycle 意为“再利用”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻再利用把那些瓶子重复用上三回（recycle the bottles three times over at once），以后再也不要提起。
recycle 意为“回收利用”，新来的伙计每个星期都照例再利用把那些瓶子重复用上三回，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 recycles。
recycle 意为“回收利用”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地回收利用把洗过东西的水再用一遍，用一般过去式 recycled 叙述。
recycle 意为“回收利用”，结尾那句是母亲 2001 年的话：要回收利用把洗过东西的水再用一遍，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和集市记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 recycle 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the trader recycled the water from the washing at once, and nobody in the market forgot it.
Even now the trader recycles the water from the washing in the rain whenever the market asks.
Recycling the water from the washing at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever recycle the bottles three times over in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new partner from the next market recycles the bottles three times over at once every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother recycled the water from the washing again, and the market remembered that half.
